//: Type-checks the test tree, which tsconfig.json deliberately does not:
its `include` is `src` alone, because it is the BUILD config and a test
file compiled into dist/ would ship. So `npm run typecheck` has never
read a line of test/, and a type-level assertion there could only be
watched go red under a scratch config.
Not wired into `task check` yet: the test tree has real type errors
today (fixture-name strings passed where a union is expected, and
unchecked index access), and fixing them is its own change. Run it by
`rootDir` is overridden rather than inherited. `src` cannot contain a
file under test/, so inheriting it fails every test file with TS6059
before type checking reaches them - which reads as 'the tests are
broken' rather than 'the config is'. Nothing is emitted here, so the
inherited outDir and declaration settings never apply.
